quote.text: Short-lived are both the praiser and the praised; and the rememberer and the remembered; and all this in a nook of this part of the world; and not even here do all agree; no not anyone with himself; and the whole earth too is a point.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the fleeting nature of praise and memory reminds us to value intrinsic virtues in our children, nurturing qualities that endure far beyond momentary accolades.
    • Embrace the impermanence of recognition, teaching your children that their worth is defined by their character and actions rather than external validation.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, understand that both critics and compliments are transient; focus on cultivating a lasting legacy of integrity and purpose that survives the tide of opinion.
    • Lead with humility by appreciating the fleeting nature of fame, remaining dedicated to principles and actions that benefit your team and society over the long-term.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, recognize that market trends, praise, and criticism are all transient factors; prioritize building solutions that offer enduring value over chasing short-lived popularity.
    • Adapt and iterate with a mindset that acknowledges impermanence—evaluate feedback and market shifts as opportunities to refine and reinforce your product's core strengths.
